app.name: GiveMePOD
app.shortDescription: GiveMePOD is an AI-powered POD command center that helps you discover product opportunities, create designs, analyze market demand, check intellectual-property risk, generate mockups, optimize listings, and prepare products for multiple selling platforms.

landing.heroTitle: Turn POD Ideas Into Market-Ready Products.
landing.heroSubtitle: Research trends, discover niches, analyze risks, create designs, generate mockups, optimize listings, and prepare your POD products — all in one workspace.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Eliminate 8 separate subscriptions. From market research to 11 commercial listing mockups in minutes.

trendResearch.title: Trend Research
trendResearch.desc: Real-time velocity tracking across Etsy, Pinterest, and search signals to identify authentic consumer demand.

nicheDiscovery.title: Niche Discovery
nicheDiscovery.desc: Drill down from broad categories into high-margin micro-niches and find untapped audience gaps.

aiDesignStudio.title: AI Design Studio
aiDesignStudio.desc: Generate high-resolution commercial print artwork or production-grade prompts formatted for direct POD printing.

riskScanner.title: POD Risk Scanner
riskScanner.desc: Automated intellectual property screening against trademarks, copyright, celebrity names, and marketplace policies.

mockupFactory.title: Mockup Factory
mockupFactory.desc: Batch-generate 11 consistent e-commerce mockups: 1 hero Etsy photo + 10 lifestyle, studio, and flat lay angles.

etsyListing.title: Etsy Listing Generator
etsyListing.desc: Generate high-converting SEO titles, 13 compliant tags, rich descriptions, materials, and buyer FAQs.

pinterestFactory.title: Pinterest Content Factory
pinterestFactory.desc: Produce 5 viral Pin concepts with targeted keywords, hooks, call-to-actions, and direct-to-board readiness.

profitCalculator.title: Profit Calculator
profitCalculator.desc: Transparent margin math accounting for production cost, shipping, marketplace fees, ads, and currency conversions.

marketAnalyzer.title: Market Opportunity Analyzer
marketAnalyzer.desc: Transparent 0–100 POD Opportunity Score calculated from demand, competition, seasonality, and IP risk.
